purpose.en: Understand exposure duration, subject movement, handholding, and panning.
purpose.zh-cn: 理解曝光时长、主体运动、手持与追随拍摄。

editorialNote.en: Example shutter speeds are starting points, not guarantees of sharpness for every subject.
editorialNote.zh-cn: 示例快门速度只是起点，不能保证所有主体都清晰。

verification.evidence: The tutorial distinguishes exposure time, motion blur, camera shake, and panning.
